# Aaron Hanson

> Staff / Principal software engineer, and a former startup CTO & founder.  A 25-year range: shipped a AAA console game, ran large-scale data pipelines, wrote audited smart contracts on mainnet, built AI-agent infrastructure, and now work on tokenized deposits for the regulated banking system.  Some of it raised $40M; all of it shipped.

This file is the machine-readable version of https://aaronhanson.dev/, static and dependency-free like the site.  My stack starts at the antenna: people say full-stack; I mean it a layer or two lower than most.

## Now
- Senior blockchain engineer at [Cari Network](https://www.cari.com/): a bank-governed network for tokenized deposits — bank-issued dollars that settle instantly and continuously, stay liabilities of the issuing bank, and so remain FDIC-insurance eligible.  Built on Prividium, a permissioned Layer-2 on the ZKsync stack anchored to Ethereum.  [White paper](https://whitepaper.cari.com/).

## What I do
- Full-stack: TypeScript, React, Node, Python, on AWS.
- Smart contracts: Solidity / EVM.  Upgradeable agentic-company contracts on Base, cleared a Zenith audit.  Permissioned L2s on the ZKsync stack (Prividium).
- AI / agents: LLM integration (Claude), Claude Code, MCP servers, agent tooling.
- Foundations: C++ (Xbox console game dev), data pipelines / ETL, real-time systems.

## Selected work
- [Rolodex](https://rolodex.xyz) (as founding engineer): a network where AI agents and the people behind them find each other.  Agents join over MCP.
- [SeekSat](https://seeksat.com): tracks any satellite live and predicts its passes over you, with sky charts for watching, Doppler and pointing charts for radio, and an MCP server that gives agents the same physics engine.
- [Precession](https://precession.dev): browser-native visualization of how a star's apparent position drifts over decades from stellar aberration and luni-solar precession + nutation; the N-body + rigid-body simulation is Rust compiled to WebAssembly, the UI a static Next.js export.
- [Solmanac](https://solmanac.app): an almanac of the Earth and Sun's year around a live analemma, computed from JPL ephemerides, with names for the clock and orbit moments that had none.
- [doppler1090](https://github.com/coffee-converter/doppler1090): a passive RTL-SDR receiver that measures the Doppler shift of ADS-B aircraft on 1090 MHz and checks it against the shift predicted from each aircraft's own reported position and velocity.
- [Bitcoin difficulty estimator](https://newhedge.io/bitcoin/difficulty-estimator): forecasts the next difficulty adjustment; built it and sold it to newhedge.io.
- [SAN Sound loadout locker](https://sansound.tech/avatar/loadout-locker): an audio-hardware brand's onchain avatar customizer; I built the whole web3 stack.
- WISE token (as CTO): a $40M raise; liquidity locked forever, LP tokens provably burned at genesis.
